digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III; Pakia (2005) App. VI

teaser.en: When this climber flowers, whole bushes seem to catch fire, and Digo naming linked it to its tree cousin long before botanists did.
teaser.sw: Mtambaa huu unapochanua, vichaka vizima huonekana kama vinawaka moto, na majina ya Kidigo yaliuhusisha na binamu yake wa mti muda mrefu kabla wataalamu wa mimea hawajafanya hivyo.
teaser.dg: Mmea hinyu unaokpwera uchilavya maruwa, vitsaka vizima vinaonekana dza vinatsoma moho; na Adigo, kpwa dzina ambaro akaupha, akauunganisha na muhi nduguye kare sana kabla ya asayansi a mimea.

summary.en: *Mkongolo wa kundu* is a scrambling climber with blazing red flower clusters and four-winged pink fruits. Its Digo name ties it to the tree *mkongolo*, a link that botany confirms, since both are *Combretum*.
summary.sw: *Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mtambaa unaotanda wenye vishada vya maua mekundu yanayowaka na matunda ya waridi yenye mabawa manne. Jina lake la Kidigo linauhusisha na mti *mkongolo*, uhusiano unaothibitishwa na sayansi ya mimea, kwa kuwa wote wawili ni *Combretum*.
summary.dg: *Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye mafungu ga maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala dza moho, na matunda ga pinki genye mapha manne. Dzinare ra Chidigo rinauunganisha na muhi *mkongolo*, na sayansi ya mimea inakubali uhusiano uhu, kpwa sababu yosi miiri ni *Combretum*.

about.en:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* is a woody scrambler that climbs over shrubs and into small trees. In flower it is unmistakable: dense clusters of brilliant scarlet flowers with long red stamens cover the branches, often when the plant has few leaves, so the colour stands out across the bush. The flowers are rich in nectar and attract sunbirds.

The fruits that follow are papery and four-winged, flushed pink, like those of other *Combretum*. The leaves are broad, simple and opposite.
about.sw:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mtambaa wenye shina gumu la kimti ambao hupanda juu ya vichaka na kuingia kwenye miti midogo. Unapochanua hauwezi kukosewa: vishada vizito vya maua mekundu angavu yenye stameni ndefu nyekundu hufunika matawi, mara nyingi wakati mmea una majani machache, kwa hiyo rangi hiyo huonekana wazi kote vichakani. Maua yana asali ya maua tele na huvutia chozi.

Matunda yanayofuata ni kama karatasi, yenye mabawa manne na rangi ya waridi, kama yale ya *Combretum* nyingine. Majani ni mapana, sahili na yanakaa kwa jozi zinazokabiliana.
about.dg:
*Mkongolo wa kundu* ni mmea wa nyama za muhi unaokpwera dzulu ya vitsaka na hadi kpwenye mihi midide. Uchikala na maruwa unamanyikana mara mwenga: mafungu maziho ga maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala sana, genye stameni mare za kundu, ganabwiningiza panda, mara nyinji wakati mmea una makodza machache, kpwa hivyo rangi inaonekana weruni kosi. Maruwa gana madzi ga mtswano manji na ganamweha vitsozi.

Matunda ganayolunga ni makavu dza karatasi, genye mapha manne, na ga pinki, dza ga *Combretum* yanjina. Makodza ni mapana, chila kodza ni zima (tarina makodza madide), na ganamera mairi-mairi ganayololana.

where.en: Look along forest edges and in riverine thicket, where it climbs over the surrounding vegetation. It is easiest to find in flower, when the red clusters can be seen from far off.
where.sw: Tafuta pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito vya kando ya mito, ambako hupanda juu ya mimea inayouzunguka. Ni rahisi zaidi kuupata unapochanua, wakati vishada vyekundu vinaweza kuonekana kutoka mbali.
where.dg: Hendza kanda-kanda ya matsaka na kpwenye vitsaka vya kanda-kanda ya miho, phatu unaphokpwera dzulu ya mimea iriyouzunguluka. Ni rahisi kuuona uchikala na maruwa, mafungu ga kundu ganaphoonekana kula kure.

uses.en: No specific Digo use has been recorded.
uses.sw: Hakuna matumizi mahususi ya Kidigo yaliyorekodiwa.
uses.dg: Takuna matumizi ga Adigo garigoandikpwa kpwa mmea hinyu.

culture.en: The name *mkongolo wa kundu* means 'red *mkongolo*'. It links the climber to the tree *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) through their similar flowers. Western botany places both in the same genus, *Combretum*, so this is a neat case where Digo plant naming and scientific classification agree.
culture.sw: Jina *mkongolo wa kundu* lina maana ya '*mkongolo* mwekundu'. Linauhusisha mtambaa huu na mti *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) kupitia maua yao yanayofanana. Sayansi ya mimea ya Kimagharibi inawaweka wote wawili katika jenasi moja, *Combretum*, kwa hiyo huu ni mfano mzuri ambapo upaji majina wa mimea wa Kidigo na uainishaji wa kisayansi vinakubaliana.
culture.dg: Dzina *mkongolo wa kundu* rina mana ya '*mkongolo* wa rangi ya kundu'. Rinauunganisha mmea hinyu unaokpwera na muhi *mkongolo* (*Combretum schumannii*) kpwa sababu maruwage ganahalana. Sayansi ya mimea ya Azungu inaika mimea yosi miiri kpwenye jenasi mwenga, *Combretum*; kpwa hivyo hinyu ni mfwano mnono wa madzina ga mimea ga Chidigo kukubaliana na mpango wa chisayansi.

names.en: Digo: *mkongolo wa kundu*, 'red *mkongolo*'. English: burning bush. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Combretum paniculatum*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mkongolo wa kundu*, '*mkongolo* mwekundu'. Kiingereza: *burning bush*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huuita *Combretum paniculatum*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mkongolo wa kundu*, ambaro manage ni '*mkongolo* wa rangi ya kundu'. Kpwa Chingereza ni *burning bush*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Combretum paniculatum*.

reason.en: The tree it is named after, also a Combretum
reason.sw: *Mkongolo*, mti ambao umepewa jina kutokana nao, nao pia ni Combretum
reason.dg: Muhi ambao mmea hinyu ukaihwa kpwa dzinare, nao ni Combretum

reason.sw: Mwanga, jamaa wa familia ya Combretum

reason.en: Another vivid red-flowered climber of forest edges
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wa pembezoni mwa misitu wenye maua mekundu angavu
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaokpwera kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye maruwa ga kundu ganayong'ala

reason.en: Climber of the same forest edges
reason.sw: Mtambaa wa pembezoni mwa misitu ile ile
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaokpwera kanda-kanda ya matsaka phapho phapho
